學.english: to learn; to study; to imitate; science; -ology

火.english: surname Huo; fire; urgent; ammunition; fiery or flaming; internal heat (Chinese medicine); hot (popular); classifier for military units (old); Kangxi radical 86

故.english: happening; instance; reason; cause; intentional; former; old; friend; therefore; hence; (of people) to die, dead

圓.english: circle; round; circular; spherical; (of the moon) full; unit of Chinese currency (yuan); tactful; to make consistent and whole (the narrative of a dream or a lie)

堂.english: (main) hall; large room for a specific purpose; CL:間|间[jian1]; relationship between cousins etc on the paternal side of a family; of the same clan; classifier for classes, lectures etc; classifier for sets of furniture

醒.english: to wake up; to be awake; to become aware; to sober up; to come to

赫.english: surname He; awe-inspiring; abbr. for 赫茲|赫兹[he4 zi1], hertz (Hz)

回.english: to circle; to go back; to turn around; to answer; to return; to revolve; Hui ethnic group (Chinese Muslims); time; classifier for acts of a play; section or chapter (of a classic book)

來.english: to come; (used as a substitute for a more specific verb); hither (directional complement for motion toward the speaker, as in 回來|回来[hui2lai5]); ever since (as in 自古以來|自古以来[zi4gu3 yi3lai2]); for the past (amount of time); (prefix) the coming ...; the next ... (as in 來世|来世[lai2shi4]); (between two verbs) in order to; (after a round number) approximately; (used after 得[de2] to indicate possibility, as in 談得來|谈得来[tan2de5lai2], or after 不[bu4] to indicate impossibility, as in 吃不來|吃不来[chi1bu5lai2])

許.english: surname Xu; to allow; to permit; to promise; to praise; somewhat; perhaps

寄.english: to entrust; to place in sb's care; (bound form) to depend on; to attach oneself to; to reside temporarily; (bound form) foster (as in 寄女[ji4nu:3] foster daughter); to send by post; to mail

在.english: to exist; to be alive; (of sb or sth) to be (located) at; (used before a verb to indicate an action in progress)

柔.english: soft; flexible; supple; yielding; rho (Greek letter Ρρ)

線.english: thread; string; wire; line; CL:條|条[tiao2],股[gu3],根[gen1]; (after a number) tier (unofficial ranking of a Chinese city)

復.english: to go and return; to return; to resume; to return to a normal or original state; to repeat; again; to recover; to restore; to turn over; to reply; to answer; to reply to a letter; to retaliate; to carry out

群.english: group; crowd; flock, herd, pack etc

選.english: to choose; to pick; to select; to elect

讓.english: to yield; to permit; to let sb do sth; to have sb do sth; to make sb (feel sad etc); by (indicates the agent in a passive clause, like 被[bei4])

程.english: surname Cheng; rule; order; regulations; formula; journey; procedure; sequence

站.english: station; to stand; to halt; to stop; branch of a company or organization; website

準.english: accurate; standard; definitely; certainly; about to become (bride, son-in-law etc); quasi-; para-

清.english: Qing (Wade-Giles: Ch'ing) dynasty of China (1644-1911); surname Qing; (of water etc) clear; clean; quiet; still; pure; uncorrupted; clear; distinct; to clear; to settle (accounts)

蘭.english: surname Lan; abbr. for Lanzhou 蘭州|兰州[Lan2zhou1], Gansu; orchid (蘭花|兰花 Cymbidium goeringii); fragrant thoroughwort (蘭草|兰草 Eupatorium fortunei); lily magnolia (木蘭|木兰)

有沒有.english: (before a noun) Do (you, they etc) have ...?; Is there a ...?; (before a verb) Did (you, they etc) (verb, infinitive)?; Have (you, they etc) (verb, past participle)?

改成.english: to convert; to turn into (sth else); to adapt (a story to another medium)

就是.english: exactly; precisely; only; simply; just; (used correlatively with 也[ye3]) even; even if

設計.english: to design; to plan; design; plan

起來.english: to stand up; to get up; also pr. [qi3lai2]; (after a verb) indicating the beginning and continuation of an action or a state; indicating an upward movement (e.g. after 站[zhan4]); indicating completion; (after a perception verb, e.g. 看[kan4]) expressing preliminary judgment; also pr. [qi3lai5]

九月.english: September; ninth month (of the lunar year)

一種.english: one kind of; one type of

來自.english: to come from (a place); From: (in email header)

時代.english: Time, US weekly news magazine; age; era; epoch; period (in one's life); CL:個|个[ge4]

多年.english: many years; for many years; longstanding

一個.english: a; an; one; the whole (afternoon, summer vacation etc)

資料.english: material; resources; data; information; profile (Internet); CL:份[fen4],個|个[ge4]

只有.english: only have ...; there is only ...; (used in combination with 才[cai2]) it is only if one ... (that one can ...) (Example: 只有通過治療才能痊愈|只有通过治疗才能痊愈[zhi3 you3 tong1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 cai2 neng2 quan2 yu4] "the only way to cure it is with therapy"); it is only ... (who ...) 畫面.english: scene; tableau; picture; image; screen (displayed by a computer); (motion picture) frame; field of view

開始.english: to begin; beginning; to start; initial; CL:個|个[ge4]

沒有.english: haven't; hasn't; doesn't exist; to not have; to not be
